content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are popular platforms for digital product sales, but they come with limitations. Gumroad charges 3.5% + $0.30 per sale, while Lemon Squeezy charges 2% + $0.30 per sale. Paddle, on the other hand, charges 5% + $0.30 per sale. These fees add up quickly, eating into creators' profit margins. In contrast, Coremerch's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a flat 0.5% fee, making it a more cost-effective option for digital product sellers.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195, leaving many creators in restricted countries without access to payment processing. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle also have country restrictions, making it difficult for creators to sell digital products without relying on a US-based payment processor. Coremerch's sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, is designed to bypass these restrictions, providing a permanent structural alternative at the base layer.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed is a critical factor for digital product sellers. Gumroad takes 2-3 business days to process payments, while Lemon Squeezy takes 1-2 business days. Paddle, however, processes payments in real-time. Coremerch's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers instant payment processing, ensuring creators get paid quickly and efficiently. When it comes to fees, Coremerch's 0.5% flat fee is a significant advantage over the percentage-based fees charged by Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle.
Coremerch's Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers instant payment processing and a flat 0.5% fee.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership and automation are critical aspects of digital product sales. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle require creators to store their products on their platforms, limiting ownership and control. Coremerch's Edge Commerce Stack ($197), on the other hand, allows creators to deploy their own infrastructure, giving them full ownership and control over their products. Automation is also a key feature of Coremerch's solution, enabling creators to set up instant delivery and payment processing without relying on a third-party platform.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
